'''SpecWar Fab''' was a [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] which produced weapons for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

Shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], both [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s forces attacked the station and were thwarted by an Imperial [[Missile Boat]].
